instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph, shot at eye-level in a medium shot with a shallow depth of field showing blurred purple flowers in the foreground. In a minimalist indoor studio with a white background, three friends sit huddled together. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3), in a white shirt over a black top, smiles gently at the camera. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2), in a white high-neck top and denim jacket, looks forward with a soft smile. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1), in a white shirt, smiles brightly at the camera. The women on the left (R3) and right (R1) wrap their arms around the center woman (R2) in a close group hug. The lighting is soft and bright.
